name: Beast Darling! ~Kemomimi Danshi to Himitsu no Ryou~
original_name: BEAST Darling! ～けもみみ男子と秘密の寮～
source: Five teenager boys are affected with a "beast" curse. This curse will give them animal tails, ears or any body feature of the animal. They will also inherit the characteristics and behaviour of said animal when their curse is activated. You, the heroine, have a special ability that you know nothing about. You can help these boys to control their beast curse properly. In fact there's something about you that you never know about and you'll only discover by getting close to them...
translation: 五个十几岁的男孩受到“野兽”诅咒的影响。这个诅咒会给他们动物的尾巴、耳朵或动物的任何身体特征。当他们的诅咒被激活时，他们还将继承所述动物的特征和行为。你，女主角，拥有你所不知道的特殊能力。你可以帮助这些男孩正确控制他们的野兽诅咒。事实上，有一些关于你的事情是你永远不知道的，只有通过接近他们才会发现……
